description: Trigger discrimination for the Phase 7 AI-platform-ops cluster: model-routing/gateway layer vs cost policy vs telemetry implementation vs credential custody vs output schema, and against the shipped observability-operator and secrets-identity-hardener, and against agent-harness-architect (agent registry) and structured-output-validator (output shape) for provider adapters and the capability matrix.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke ai-router-architect. Design the gateway all our model calls go through — provider selection, fallback when one is down, and one place to hold the keys.
cases.reason: The routing/gateway layer (selection, fallback, custody, choke point) is this skill; ai-cost-guardrail-designer sets the budget policy it enforces and observability-operator implements the telemetry it emits.

cases.prompt: Set the token caps, per-tenant budgets, and rate limits for our AI feature and defend against token-drain.
cases.reason: The consumption/cost policy is ai-cost-guardrail-designer; the router enforces those limits but doesn't decide them.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke observability-operator. Implement the dashboards and alerts for our AI call latency, error rate, and cost.
cases.reason: Hands-on dashboard/alert implementation is observability-operator; the router defines the per-call telemetry contract and emits it, but doesn't build the dashboards.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke secrets-identity-hardener. Our provider API key leaked into the client bundle via a VITE_ variable — move it server-side and rotate it.
cases.reason: Moving/rotating a leaked secret with a bundle-absence proof is secrets-identity-hardener; the router composes it for custody but the remediation itself is that skill's.

cases.prompt: Define and enforce the JSON schema the model must return so downstream code can rely on the shape.
cases.reason: Output shape/schema validation is structured-output-validator; the router moves requests/responses but doesn't own the output contract.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke ai-router-architect. We are swapping one model provider for another. Design the adapter that maps its tool calls, streaming and errors onto our internal model interface, plus the conformance tests it must pass.
cases.reason: Per-provider adapters, the capability matrix and adapter conformance tests are this skill's extension (D70); agent-harness-architect keeps the agent's closed tool and provider registry, not the provider-to-interface mapping.

cases.prompt: Design the closed, versioned tool and provider registry our agent runtime checks, so an unknown capability fails instead of being improvised.
cases.reason: The agent's closed tool/provider registry and fail-on-unknown rule belong to agent-harness-architect; the router maps providers onto its interface but does not own the agent registry.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke ai-router-architect. Our fallback model cannot produce structured output. Make sure routing and fallback never send a structured-output task to a model that lacks that feature.
cases.reason: Which model may receive a task, checked against a capability matrix, is routing and fallback design in this skill; structured-output-validator owns the output schema, not model selection.
